text:
Nina Alvarez: Dropping a quick design check for the Alerting thresholds panel + notification preview. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (frames: thresholds/stepper-v2, preview/order-behavior). Need copy + a11y sanity pass. Priya Desai: The stepper + slider combo looks neat but the stepper increments by 0.1 and the visual label shows integers. Confusing for users. Suggest either show decimals in the label or switch stepper to whole-number steps with a secondary fractional input. Omar Khan: Agree on stepper mismatch. Also the preview list still shows channels in alphabetical order. In runtime the routing is priority -> fallback. The preview should reflect that or add a badge to indicate runtime priority. Luke Foster: Copy nit: we use both "Mute for" and "Snooze for" in the console. Pick one. "Snooze" might be more familiar in alerts context. Priya Desai: Accessibility: the slider doesn't announce its current value when focused via keyboard on some screen readers. We should expose aria-valuetext and a visible numeric input fallback. A11y-Bot: Recommended: add aria-live region for preview changes and use role="list"/"listitem" for the channel preview to help SR users navigate order. Example: ```html
Preview: showing 3 channels (1 high priority)
  • Pager (priority)
  • Slack #infra
  • Email (fallback)
``` Nina Alvarez: Good call. For copy, I'd like to standardize on "Snooze" unless PMs push back. Also thinking the CTA on preview should be "Save changes" rather than "Apply" to set clear persistence semantics. Omar Khan: +1 for "Save changes". Also propose a small "Runtime preview" toggle that overlays whether the preview is simulated (alphabetical) or runtime-accurate; tooltip: "Runtime preview shows routing & fallbacks based on current policy." Priya Desai: For mobile, the threshold stepper and the tiny slider UI collide. Could collapse the slider into a single row with a numeric input and a mini-visual bar. That keeps keyboard input easy. Luke Foster: I'll update copy doc with: 1) "Snooze for" label, 2) CTA -> "Save changes", 3) helper: "Snooze notifications in selected channels for the chosen duration." Keep it short. Nina Alvarez: Action items: @Priya implement aria-valuetext + numeric fallback, @Omar prototype runtime-order preview and the toggle, @Luke push copy PR. We'll review Thursday 9am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
